metadata.method: Independent file inventory and JSON/gzip/GeoJSON parsing, exact metadata projection, row/meta source-review signals, dataset-specific review matching with exact aggregate exceptions, available generation/source-ID/download-time/full-receipt snapshot guards and omission audit. Catalog producer not imported.
metadata.scope: The delivered additive transport/evidence families listed by the independent inventory; excludes manifests, API/field/retrieval references and the index itself.

exclusions.reason: source manifest; acquisition receipts are not normalized observations
source registry; not delivered transport observations
frozen raw source inventory; not transport observation or derived coverage evidence
dated route reference; not measured travel times
source manifest; acquisition receipts are not normalized observations

limitations: This checks the index and its review pointers, not a second interpretation of every original transport source.
within_documented_scope_only never means global data acceptance; unknown publication states, bounded acquisition and unresolved walking/ID limits remain in original records and listed limitations.
Acquisition coverage/delivery and ID-reference diagnostics have separate kinds and are not counted as measured traffic or travel-time observations.

Snapshot checks use only identifiers recorded by the independent report. Explicit legacy checklist/control exceptions without generation or receipt identity cannot prove an otherwise unrecorded same-count content change; they never extend to new observation files.
Travel endpoint observations grow by batch. Counts apply to the recorded local snapshot and must be re-audited after new files or reports arrive.
